{{Quote|Four weeks of firefight and not a ''scratch'' on my flight suit! It's probably why we got this gig. I'm ''blessed'', I tell you.|Vhall|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
'''Vhall''' was a [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] who piloted a [[Nothoiin swoop]] during the [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberation]] of [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]]. Assigned to be an [[honor guard]] during the [[Goldskin Parade]], he was incapacitated by members of [[Team Dosho]].
